nueva_partida.invitado_1: Now you can play as a guest with the code

tutorial.dialogo_0: Hello! I’m a Park Ranger and I’ll give you some instructions. Are you ready?
tutorial.dialogo_1: To walk, use the keys: A to go left, D to go right, S to go backwards, and W to go forward.
tutorial.dialogo_2: With the mentioned keys, you can walk and explore the forest. Now let’s practice.
tutorial.dialogo_3: Follow me and walk forward to collect the red spheres. Let’s go!
tutorial.dialogo_4: You learn very quickly! But do you know how to run?
tutorial.dialogo_5: You don’t? Well, it’s easy — just press Shift while walking.
tutorial.dialogo_6: Let’s practice again and collect the green spheres. Don’t forget to run using Shift.
tutorial.dialogo_7: Good job! You learn very fast.
tutorial.dialogo_8: Now let’s try jumping. Look how fun it is! Would you like to learn?
tutorial.dialogo_9: To jump, press the Space key. Give it a try!
tutorial.dialogo_12: Now you can begin your adventure.

bruno.sentence_0: Welcome to the PROSPERINA PROTECTED FOREST
bruno.sentence_1: Complete the challenges in each station to become a DIGITAL PARK RANGER
bruno.sentence_2:
1. Explore the cabins 
2. Interact with the excursion groups

cabanas_info.sentence_animales_0: Here you can learn about the mammals that live in the Prosperina Forest
cabanas_info.sentence_animales_1: Approach the light of each interactive screen and you can scroll through the images
cabanas_info.sentence_animales_2: Press the info button to learn more about the image you are viewing
cabanas_info.sentence_aves_0: In this cabin you can learn about several bird species that live in the Prosperina Protected Forest
cabanas_info.sentence_aves_1: You must approach the blue light and stand in front of each screen to see their photos and read their information
cabanas_info.sentence_flora_0: Here you can learn important information about the flora that inhabits the Prosperina Forest
cabanas_info.sentence_flora_1: Approach the light of each interactive screen and you can scroll through the images
cabanas_info.sentence_flora_2: Press the info button to learn more about the image you are viewing

excursionistas.sentence_grupo_0: I don’t think we’re ready to go yet — we must make sure we have everything we need!
excursionistas.sentence_grupo_1: Let’s go to the main gate to enter the Prosperina Protected Forest
excursionistas.sentence_grupo_2: Once we pass the gate, our excursion begins!

cabana_animal.animal_0_sentence_2: Dry, humid, and montane forests, including mature and secondary forests

cabana_aves.ave_0_sentence_1: Perches in the open at the forest edge, glides regularly, keeping wings flat and tail fanned.
cabana_aves.ave_1_sentence_1: Active only at night, sleeps under dense foliage, often on branches exposed high above the ground.
cabana_aves.ave_1_sentence_2: Observed in humid forested area of Monkey Hill in BPP.
cabana_aves.ave_2_sentence_1: Small flocks, often forage in open areas, characteristically lifting the tail halfway.
cabana_aves.ave_2_sentence_2: Observed around reservoirs and humid areas of BPP.
cabana_aves.ave_3_sentence_1: Found alone or in pairs, generally noisy and conspicuous. Hunts a wide variety of insects and also feeds on fruit.
cabana_aves.ave_4_sentence_1: Spotted on fences along roadsides and in semi-open areas, with fast and direct flight in open skies.
cabana_aves.ave_4_sentence_2: Low and arid areas with trees, from reservoirs to viewpoints.
cabana_aves.ave_5_sentence_1: Usually perches high in trees. Inspects and pecks trunks and branches for insects, also eats fruits and catches insects in the air.
cabana_aves.ave_6_sentence_1: Feeds mainly on insects caught during aerial sallies, also consumes fruit.
cabana_aves.ave_7_sentence_1: Territorial and competitive, feeding on flower nectar and helping to pollinate them. Males perform vertical flights with dives during courtship.
cabana_aves.ave_8_sentence_1: Usually in pairs or small groups, foraging at various levels.
cabana_aves.ave_8_sentence_2: Observed in forested areas of BPP.
cabana_aves.ave_10_sentence_1: Often in pairs, regularly raises crown feathers into a round, fluffy crest while nodding alertly.
cabana_aves.ave_10_sentence_2: Observed in the forested areas of BPP.
cabana_aves.ave_11_sentence_1: Feeds mainly on large insects such as cicadas, striking them against a branch or the ground before eating, also consumes small amounts of fruit.
cabana_aves.ave_12_sentence_2: Observed on firebreak lines and dirt roads of BPP.
cabana_aves.ave_13_sentence_1: Bold and easy to observe. Found mainly in pairs, feeding at low and mid levels. Sometimes in mixed, scattered flocks.
cabana_aves.ave_14_sentence_1: Often perches while scanning its surroundings, swinging its tail back and forth.

first_challege_d.sentence_0: Hello, I'm Paco! And I welcome you to the Prosperina Protected Forest.
first_challege_d.sentence_1: Explore and protect the forest and its species to become a Ranger.
first_challege_d.sentence_2: To interact with objects and learn about the animals and plants of the forest, center them in the AIM POINT on your screen and CLICK on them.
first_challege_d.sentence_3: On a real visit to the forest you need the help of a GUIDE who will inform you of the route, and that there are areas that could be dangerous.
first_challege_d.sentence_4: To get familiar with the forest, your first mission will be to find 3 species: a squirrel, an iguana, and a pechiche tree.

conseguir_libro.sentence_0:
Now that you know how to move, we’ll give you this book.
In it you can record the species you find in the forest when you interact with them. To open it, press the L key.
conseguir_libro.sentence_1:
To interact with the trees and little animals in the forest:
Place the AIM POINT where you want and CLICK on them.
conseguir_libro.sentence_2: Make sure to find them all to earn great rewards later on.

second_challenge_d.sentence_0:
It’s time to start using that book a bit more.
Find a squirrel, an iguana, and a pechiche tree in the forest and interact with them to record them in your book.
second_challenge_d.sentence_1: To interact with the trees and little animals in the forest, place the AIM POINT where you want and CLICK on them.
second_challenge_d.sentence_2: To see the clues of where the species you need to look for are located, press the P key.
second_challenge_d.sentence_completado:
By exploring the station you’ve discovered species of the Prosperina Protected Forest.
Keep exploring the new stations and missions.
second_challenge_d.sentence_pendiente: Interact with the species of the forest to access the next station, remember that we have a great variety of animals and trees.

third_challengue_d.sentence_0: It has left its burrow. It’s dangerous for it to be out of its home, since other animals could attack or hurt it.
third_challengue_d.sentence_1: Explore around, we must save it but it’s a little tricky. Be fast and CATCH IT, then RETURN it to the burrow as quickly as possible by CLICKING.
third_challengue_d.sentence_completado: Thank you for saving the baby rabbit, it’s now safe in its burrow. Remember that if it’s a bird or a reptile you shouldn’t approach and it’s better to tell an adult for help.
third_challengue_d.sentence_pendiente: The baby rabbit needs your help. CATCH the rabbit and then RETURN it to its burrow using click.

fourth_challenge_d.sentence_suelo: Look at the ground! Species are very important for life in the forest, don’t step on them carelessly!
fourth_challenge_d.sentence_0: Our friend the Gray-backed Hawk has hurt one of its wings and cannot get its food on its own.
fourth_challenge_d.sentence_1:
For this challenge you must LOOK for two mice and a salamander. Pay attention, you may hear them when you’re close.

To ask for help press the P key.
fourth_challenge_d.sentence_2:
Once you’ve captured the food, you must place them in the indicated area by clicking.

This is an example of a food chain of the species and how they feed.
fourth_challenge_d.sentence_completado: Thank you for hunting food for the Gray-backed Hawk, we’re sure it will recover soon and be able to hunt on its own. In a real forest avoid approaching its food.
fourth_challenge_d.sentence_pendiente:
COLLECT the food and LEAVE it in the designated area using your CLICK.
Our friend is counting on you to recover. Search the surroundings, you’ll surely find what it needs.

fifth_challenge_d.sentence_vidrio: Glass in the sun works like a magnifying glass and can ignite dry leaves. Always pick it up to prevent fires and take care of the planet.
fifth_challenge_d.sentence_0:
It seems that some visitors have left trash in the LAKE. This should never happen when you visit a forest, a beach, or a river.
Help us PICK IT UP and SORT IT into its proper bin.
fifth_challenge_d.sentence_1: To pick up the trash you must CLICK and it will be stored in your backpack. To deposit it in its bin press M and then DRAG it to the correct bin.
fifth_challenge_d.title_basura: Oh no! Look how much trash is here
fifth_challenge_d.sentence_basura: When trash gets into the water, animals get sick and cannot live well!
fifth_challenge_d.sentence_completado:
You’ve collected and classified the trash found in the Forest.
Show concern for nature. Remember never to leave waste in it.
fifth_challenge_d.sentence_pendiente:
PICK UP the trash from the LAKE to prevent pollution and keep the forest animals from getting hurt.
Open the backpack with the M key and DRAG it to the correct trash bin.

seventh_challenge_d.sentence_0: Someone left a campfire burning that could start a fire in the Forest.
seventh_challenge_d.sentence_1: First FIND a container and then LOOK for a water source to put out the fire. REMEMBER the places visited on the journey.
seventh_challenge_d.sentence_completado_0:
You’ve put out the campfire, and prevented a forest fire.

You’re a true Nature Protector Ranger!!!
seventh_challenge_d.sentence_completado_1: Pick up your Ranger badge and let’s celebrate with the other explorers!
seventh_challenge_d.sentence_pendiente_0: We can’t get distracted, we must PUT OUT the FIRE before it causes a forest fire!
seventh_challenge_d.sentence_pendiente_1:
There’s a WELL nearby, but it’s surely CLOSED.

There’s also a LAKE but we need a CONTAINER to bring the water...

Do you have an idea?
seventh_challenge_d.sentence_fallado:
It looks like you couldn’t help us with the fire. Luckily, the problem was solved before a catastrophe.
Continue to the next station.
seventh_challenge_d.sentence_wellzone_0: You found a well! Wells have a deep hole from which water is extracted.
seventh_challenge_d.sentence_wellzone_1: A bucket is thrown inside and recovered full of water with a rope.
seventh_challenge_d.sentence_wellzone_2: It’s sealed for safety but maybe we can find something useful near the well to collect water. SEARCH around.

sixth_challenge_d.sentence_aire: The fresh air you breathe comes from the trees. Thank you, trees!
sixth_challenge_d.sentence_0:
You’ve managed to overcome many missions and you’re very close to becoming a Ranger.
Now you must PLANT two trees in the GREENHOUSE.
sixth_challenge_d.sentence_1: To do this, DRAG the seeds you’ve obtained from your BACKPACK to the GROUND in the MARKED AREA.
sixth_challenge_d.sentence_completado: Very good, the viewpoint is just a few steps ahead. Don’t stop now!
sixth_challenge_d.sentence_pendiente:
You just need to DRAG the seeds into the indicated area.

Head to the GREENHOUSE to plant and open your backpack with the M key.

carteles_bosque.entrada_bosque: PROTECT THE FOREST, IT’S OUR HOME!
carteles_bosque.primer_nivel: FOLLOW THE PATH, DON’T GET LOST!
carteles_bosque.segundo_nivel: RESPECT THE ANIMALS, WATCH THEM FROM AFAR!
carteles_bosque.llegada_lago: SPEAK SOFTLY, ANIMALS ARE SLEEPING AND LISTENING!
carteles_bosque.antes_nivel_4: AVOID STARTING FIRES, PROTECT THE FOREST!
